jobs.description: We Are Breaking The Law LawAdvisor was founded in 2015 in Melbourne, Australia with a fearless and ambitious belief: that everybody should have access to justice. We hypothesised that the high costs, inefficiencies, and difficulties of obtaining legal help could be overcome simply by providing greater access to legal information, and by providing everybody with real-time access to high-quality, affordable lawyers online. Our mission has since been supported by thousands of lawyers and has allowed us to expand and set up offices across the globe. We've also attracted high-profile investors and partners who have shared our mission to transform legal service delivery. We're still not satisfied. The potential exists to completely revolutionise the practice of law. The start of this decade has delivered LawAdvisor with a new mandate: to overhaul and transform how lawyers work, and how people interact with and consume legal services, with state-of-the-art legal practise management technology to (i) increase efficiencies; (ii) automate routine processes; (iii) increase transparency; (iv) bring the legal practice to the 21st century. We Need A Novice Juggler Our Associate Product Manager relishes in the idea of being a part of a team that moves mountains. They know better than to falter when opportunities aren’t handed to them because they know that nothing good will ever come easy. Remaining steadfast and diligent, they’re prepared to get their hands dirty and navigate through the variety of tasks that they’ll take ownership over. Teaming up with our Product Managers, you’ll solve problems and facilitate communication across our cross-functional team and align them in order to shape, influence, and refine our products. An intimate understanding of our market and product suite helps us surmount any obstacle facing us whether it may be competitors, client and stakeholder feedback, or the creation of new products and features. You’ll be ready to learn from the best and continuously supercharge your professional growth and knowledge through our resources, tools, and first-hand experience. You Will Be the professor of our users’ “pain points”. You empathise with our clients and can describe the problems we are trying to solve. Collaborate with and manage the product development team alongside the Product Manager. Gather, analyse, and apply our quantitative and qualitative data and feedback to elevate our products. Ideate new solutions and opportunities as well as analyse research with the product team to determine how it can align with our product goals. Help facilitate communication within cross-functional teams throughout the product lifecycle from conceptualisation to launch day and beyond. Use your in-depth understanding of our products to deliver training to our internal teams and external stakeholders to promote optimal product knowledge. Learn and grow: gain knowledge and experience through watching and/or participating in the creation of product roadmaps, product strategy, and product plans as they happen. Become a leader: you gain first-hand experience through the Product Manager on how to delegate, manage and lead cross-functional teams to product success. You Should Have A Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Business Management, Marketing, a similar related field, or equivalent practical experience. Minimum of 2 years of experience as an Associate Product Manager, Product Analyst, Scrum Master, or practical experience in the development and/or launch of a product. Experience working both autonomously and in cross-functional teams. Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills: you are an essential part of our communication as you harmonise the voices, needs, and concerns of our stakeholders, product team, and clients. The ability to build domain and industry knowledge quickly. Bonus Points Thrive under pressure. Experience in the development and launch of a product or feature. jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description: Sonatype is the software supply chain security company. We provide the world’s best end-to-end software supply chain security solution, combining the only proactive protection against malicious open source, the only enterprise grade SBOM management and the leading open source dependency management platform. This empowers enterprises to create and maintain secure, quality, and innovative software at scale. As founders of Nexus Repository and stewards of Maven Central, the world’s largest repository of Java open-source software, we are software pioneers and our open source expertise is unmatched. We empower innovation with an unparalleled commitment to build faster, safer software and harness AI and data intelligence to mitigate risk, maximize efficiencies, and drive powerful software development. More than 2,000 organizations, including 70% of the Fortune 100 and 15 million software developers, rely on Sonatype to optimize their software supply chains. Our groundbreaking, full-spectrum platform empowers customers to rapidly create, deploy, and maintain innovative software at scale, all while aligning directly to their business needs. Trusted by more than 2,000 organizations—including 70% of the Fortune 100—and over 15 million software developers, Sonatype’s tools and guidance help deliver exceptional, secure software. From inventing modern artifact management with Nexus Repository to introducing the world’s only solution that halts malicious open-source malware in its tracks, we’re committed to constant innovation. We leverage AI/ML to give our clients, developers, and the industry complete confidence in the quality, automation, and security of their software. Learn more at www.sonatype.com. Position Overview: As a Product Manager , you will focus on the core Nexus Repository product . You will support the Product Management team by building product objectives and roadmaps while leading execution teams to bring compelling, viable solutions to fruition. You will work in close alignment with engineering squads, product design, product marketing, sales engineering, and customer success to drive impactful features for developers globally. What You will do Drive Core Execution: Own the roadmap and feature execution for the core Nexus Repository, identifying and eliminating bottlenecks to ensure timely delivery. Define & Measure Success: Establish mechanisms to accurately measure and inform your product’s in-market performance, adoption, and future functionality. Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate across Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Support, and Sales Engineering to build, market, and support scalable solutions. Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with peer Product Managers for Platform, security, and AI governance features to ensure a cohesive end-to-end platform experience. Process Optimization: Continuously develop personal expertise in product management practices, exploring new methods for effective prioritization and execution. What You’ll Bring Technical & Software Development Background: Prior hands-on experience in software development or engineering (even brief/past experience, software projects, or coding background) is strongly preferred. A clear, practical understanding of software development at scale, enterprise compliance, artifact repositories, and security controls within the SDLC. Ownership & Drive: A proven track record of taking end-to-end ownership, navigating organizational roadblocks, and making a tangible impact. Industry Context: Background and familiarity in Enterprise Software, SaaS, or highly regulated environments (e.g., Banking/Finance) is a strong plus, combined with an agile, flexible growth mindset. Stakeholder Management: Experience working directly with Engineering Directors, Product Designers, and engineering teams. Education: A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field is highly desirable. What Makes You A Stro

jobs.title: Product Analyst
jobs.description: Position Summary: The Product Analyst is a data-driven and detail-oriented professional responsible for supporting the analysis, maintenance, and enhancement of healthcare data products. The role combines US healthcare claims data analysis, product validation, requirements documentation, dashboard development, and cross-functional collaboration. The ideal candidate will have strong problem-solving abilities and hands-on experience using SQL, Power BI, and Excel to analyze complex datasets, investigate issues, assess business impact, and generate actionable insights. The Product Analyst will work closely with Product Owners, Product Managers, Data Engineering, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Engagement, and Account teams. This role will report to Product Owner. Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to: Represents the Product team on all active projects. Participates in the daily application operations / development stand-up meetings. Supports data delivery for the clients subscribed to the product. Work closely with team and stakeholders to develop and deliver high-quality data products. Analyze large US healthcare claims datasets to identify patterns, data-quality issues, coverage gaps, and product-improvement opportunities. Write and optimize SQL queries for data extraction, profiling, reconciliation, validation, and impact analysis. Compare datasets and product outputs to assess the impact of source changes, revised business rules, data-period changes, and product enhancements. Investigate complex data and product issues, perform root-cause analysis, assess business impact, and recommend practical solutions. Analyze medical claims, pharmacy claims, prescription, payer, formulary, and patient-level data across patient, claim, payer, plan, and other relevant levels. Support the validation of product outputs, analytical processes, data transformations, and machine-learning-generated results. Create and maintain product documentation, including data dictionaries, business rules, requirements, test scenarios, and validation results. Support functional testing, data validation, regression testing, defect investigation, and user acceptance testing. Support feasibility assessments and proof-of-concept initiatives for new healthcare data and analytics capabilities. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering (B.E.) or in Technology (B. Tech.). Degree in computer science or related fields preferred. Minimum Required 1 to 3 years of experience in healthcare analytics, product analysis, business analysis, data analysis, or a related role. Strong problem-solving skills, including the ability to structure ambiguous business questions, investigate data discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and recommend actionable solutions. Strong hands-on experience with SQL, Power BI, and Microsoft Excel. Hands-on experience analyzing US healthcare data, with exposure to one or more of the following datasets, data sources, or equivalent healthcare datasets: Medical, pharmacy claims, and patient-level data, such as McKesson Compile, Symphony PatientSource, Komodo Health or equivalent sources. Formulary and market-access data, such as MMIT, DRG Fingertip, or equivalent sources. Preferred: Hands-on experience with Snowflake. Understanding of medical and pharmacy claims, payer hierarchies, BIN-PCN-Group data, formulary data, market access, or patient-services analytics. Exposure to longitudinal patient analysis, treatment patterns, patient journeys, or payer-access analytics. Familiarity with Python, APIs, JSON, or machine-learning output validation. Experience with Azure DevOps, Jira, or Agile product-development practices. Working knowledge of US Healthcare / Market Access would be an advantage. Experience developing in HIPAA compliant ecosystem. Other Required: May require travel domestically and/or internationally including overnight stays up to 5%. Competencies: Communication Skills : Written, Verbal, and Presenta

Has direct domain exposure to healthcare EHR and practice management platforms through her recent role at Bravura.
Brings strong technical foundational skills including SQL, database concepts, API testing, and Jira/Agile product development practices.
Has hands-on experience with functional testing, data validation, regression testing, and defect investigation from her extensive QA background.
gaps: The role requires specialized, hands-on data analysis of US healthcare claims datasets (medical, pharmacy, payer, formulary data), which is not explicitly evidenced in her resume.
While she knows SQL, the role demands heavy daily use of Power BI and advanced Excel for dashboard development and complex data profiling, which are not highlighted in her core skills.
The position focuses heavily on data engineering reconciliation, healthcare analytics, and data delivery pipelines rather than general product management and UI/UX delivery.
jobs.reasoning_summary: Arsema meets the general experience band and has impressive technical and QA foundations, alongside some healthcare software exposure. jobs.title: Founding Product Manager
jobs.description: Askdodo · San Francisco / Bay Area (in-person preferred) Full-time · Equity + Salary The best AI shouldn’t live behind a closed wall. Askdodo is building consumer AI on frontier open-source models — so users get cutting-edge capability without being locked into one lab’s stack. Privacy is how we ship it: no surveillance tax, user control, private by design. Open models are the mission; privacy is the foundation that makes that mission trustworthy. We’re hiring a founding Product Manager — someone early in their career who can own product end-to-end with the founders. Marketing and public brand stay with the founding team; you make the product impossible to leave. What you’ll do Own core product loops: chat + API experience, onboarding, retention, and privacy UX that users actually understand Turn “private by design” into clear product decisions (not marketing copy) Ship fast with eng — specs, prioritization, experiments, launch notes Talk to users (power users, privacy-conscious builders, early adopters) and turn signal into roadmap Partner with founders on positioning when product needs a public narrative Must-haves Technical background (CS / eng / math / physics degree or equivalent technical work) Experience or internships at an AI / consumer software company (or shipping consumer products with real users) Passion for consumer products — you obsess over craft, clarity, and delight Comfortable in US / Bay Area startup culture Early-career founding energy (new grad to ~2–4 years) — IC who still ships, not a process PM Curious about open source LLMs and privacy Nice-to-haves Built or shipped an AI feature, agent workflow, or consumer app (0→1 signal) Comfortable reading technical docs / APIs (OpenAI-compatible stacks a plus) Cross-cultural experience Some public presence (writing, demos, podcasts) is a bonus Not a fit Pure brand / CMO / social-first marketers (founders cover that) Enterprise B2B PMs with no consumer DNA Non-technical PMs who can’t partner deeply with eng Big-co process owners who need heavy process to move How to apply Apply via Handshake / Crimson Careers, or email with: Your résumé A short note on one consumer or AI product you shipped (or would ship) and why open-source LLMs matter to you About the Company: AskDoDo is a frontier AIGC and AI Agent platform that prioritizes high degrees of freedom and extreme privacy protection. We target core overseas markets including Europe, the US, Japan, and Korea, offering end-to-end generation services across text, images, video, and novels. We uphold “Uncensored Capability” as a core value. Built on anonymity, end-to-end encryption, transparent routing, and deeply integrated open-source models, we commit to collecting no user data and completely eliminating privacy risks. Our vision is to build a powerful multi-model Coding-Agent that enables AI to autonomously complete complex tasks in real code and tool environments — becoming a truly trusted and empowering productivity tool for developers and creators worldwide. Why Join Us Own the core, not a cog : You will lead the end-to-end development of the AI Agent layer from 0 to 1 — defining how AI autonomously completes tasks in real environments and directly shaping AskDoDo’s most critical user experience. Flat structure, top-tier rewards : Extremely flat team (Shanghai office) with direct reporting to the business lead. We are strictly merit-based and offer highly competitive compensation (benchmarked against core levels at major tech companies, with a million-RMB annual base) plus significant early-stage equity. Proven DNA, unlimited upside : The founding team has validated overseas B2C success and a clear commercial path. As a member of the early elite team, your career growth and leadership opportunities have no ceiling. Pure geek vision : This is a geek’s mission to defend technical freedom and privacy. Push the limits of AI autonomous coding with the hardest-core technology and deliver truly secure Privacy AI to us

jobs.title: Product Manager - Growth & Website (m/f/d)
jobs.description: We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning. If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz! What You'll Own The website, GEO, and the acquisition funnel, for the Career Professionals (individual, B2P) and Self Serve Employers (under 250 employees, under roughly $20,000 a year, no salesperson) segments specifically. Self-serve conversion, from first visit through signup, upgrade, and, eventually, the point where an account outgrows self-serve and hands off to the Assisted tier. The B2P and SMB messaging, in practice, not just in the shared Messaging Framework, this is the one seat that gets to see directly whether that messaging actually converts. What Success Looks Like A defensible, evidence-backed answer to the LTV:CAC question this seat's own existence is gated on. A written, documented Critical User Journey for the self-serve signup and upgrade path, which currently doesn't exist anywhere in the registry, despite being arguably the easiest journey in the company to document precisely, since nobody has to be interviewed to understand it. Growth in self-serve revenue that either justifies this becoming a permanent Senior PM seat, or, just as validly, a clear, honest case that it shouldn't. What We're Looking For Real self-serve growth experience.Funnel optimization, conversion, GEO, and a track record of moving a number without a sales team's help. Comfort being precise about what the product actually does.The current messaging pillar "one system, individual to enterprise" is accurate for the core learner product but not for Command, since Self Serve Employers get no Command at all. You'll need to hold that distinction in your own funnel copy rather than overclaim it. A bias toward writing things down.This seat starts with more open whitespace, no CUJ, no dedicated pod, than almost any other seat in the org, and the person who takes it will be building the paper trail as much as the funnel. At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow. Ready to shape what’s next? Join us and help build the future with us. Her technical background allows her to write precise copy and understand the distinction between product tiers without overclaiming functionality.

jobs.reasoning_summary: Arsema is an exceptionally strong fit for this growth and funnel-ownership role given her direct, documented experience with Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), self-serve conversion optimization, and building product workflows from an absolute blank page. Her only slight friction is the enterprise context of a 150-year-old brand versus her agility-focused SaaS background, but her core competencies line up remarkably well.

jobs.description: Job Overview At Relativity, we make software to help users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it. Our e-discovery platform is used by more than 13,000 organizations around the world to manage large volumes of data and quickly identify key issues during litigation, internal investigations, and compliance projects. The Product Management team is looking for a Product Manager to lead the roadmap and success of Relativity’s document conversion and enrichment technology to drive efficiency in litigation review. These areas of the product are responsible for many enrichments in Processing, Imaging, PDF Production/App and drive many document transformations for review. A successful candidate must be energized by building deep customer empathy, collaborating with design, development, discovering opportunities through data analysis and inquiry with customers, creating and communicating progress through leading indicators, developing strong fluency in cloud architecture and adjacent technologies, and navigating ambiguity given the technology’s pace of change. Job Description and Requirements In this role, you will: Drive short- and long-term roadmap of document conversion and enrichment teams by working closely with both internal and external end users, engineering, enablement, sales teams and other customer-focused teams. Work with other data enrichment product managers and stakeholders to create cohesive, intuitive enrichment architecture needed to improve user experience of processing and other enrichment consumers in the product. Collaborate with sales and marketing to increase adoption of document conversion technology and create artifacts that articulate benefits of document conversion and enrichment. Ensure customers have successful experiences by helping Relativity enablement teams and acting with urgency to address any barriers to adoption. Role Responsibilities Customer Centric: Connect with external and internal customers to gain a deep understanding of their workflows and needs and validate our approach to addressing them. Ensure we are solving the most pressing problems of our customers. The ability to prioritize tasks based on their impact and outcomes is crucial to be successful in this role. Speak to internal stakeholders including engineering, user researchers, and designers about the variety of workflows and end user needs we see across segments and personas. Provide product and workflows recommendations grounded in both customer empathy and customer data. Communicate our user needs to engineering teams and other internal stakeholders to drive alignment internally on product vision. Conduct user and competitive research for their product(s) Product Leadership: Possess an in-depth understanding of our product suite. Speak about our production from a business and technical approach in a way that internal stakeholders and clients can understand. Own the product roadmap and backlog for your product(s). Listen to different internal experts to understand the impact, but in the end decide the features that your team should build. Work directly with Product Leads to help build a strategy and goals for their product(s). Track and reports on key product metrics that are relevant to your domain and expected outcomes. Act as a leader, facilitating communication across internal stakeholders and effectively communicate ‘why’ and gain buy-in from the team and Leadership. Be responsible for clarifying and resolving conflicts around your product vision. Technical Leadership Work closely with your Engineering counterparts to ensure that the team delivers a product that meets our scalability, reliability, usability, observability, efficiency and performance standards. Be well versed in technical aspects of cloud platform architecture with deeper technical understanding to communicate with development team members and make informed decisions about the product development. jobs.description: Hi! I'm [Shriya](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shriya-baddula-4b0b41386), and I lead QA at Ashby. We're hiring a QA Engineer to help us test and strengthen the quality of our product. I think of QA as something you build into the system, not as something you layer on top for added confidence. I'm not interested in gatekeeping quality or creating a process for its own sake. I care about feedback that's fast and useful, the kind engineers trust, and catching the problems users would actually notice. That's what brought me to Ashby. Engineers take on a lot of ownership, including the quality of their work, which often means they test it themselves. QA here isn't about convincing people to care or taking quality off their plate. It's about being another set of eyes on a fast-evolving product. Sometimes that means seeing the edge case. Sometimes that means spotting the product's blind spot before it hits production. In this role, you'll decide what to test, when to test, and which product areas are worth automating. We're a small team, so the work is mixed. We all roll up our sleeves when needed. **Most of your time, roughly 70%, is hands-on manual testing.** You'll work with engineers and other stakeholders on features as they ship, reproduce bugs reported by customers, and, for larger launches, coordinate testing across an entire feature area. The other 30% is automation. You'll write Playwright end-to-end tests and help expand test coverage. You do not need to be an SDET, and you do not need to have built a framework from scratch. **You do need to be comfortable writing code**, reading someone else's code, and getting better at both. If you've written some E2E tests and want to write more, that's the right starting point. We have an existing Playwright suite and page object structure you'll build on, and SDETs who will pair with you and help you grow. What Ashby gives you in return is the best of both early and growth-stage environments. The agency and no-nonsense of a seed startup: you decide what to test, work directly with the people building it, and operate in an almost-no-meeting culture. The product-market fit and scale of a growth-stage startup: 100,000+ weekly active users who depend on our software, which means the things you catch actually matter. We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway. We’ll share more details once we meet. ### **Why You Should or Shouldn’t Apply** - You have strong product instincts. You test like a user and know the difference between "it works" and "it works the way someone would actually use it." - You're good at reproducing bugs. When something is broken, you narrow it down. You don't file vague bugs and move on. - You are self-sufficient and can scope your own work. Given a feature and a spec, you decide what's worth testing and what’s not, and you know when to ask for help when something is taking too long. - You want to grow on the automation side. You don't need to be an expert to be interested. You want to write more tests, get faster at it, and learn from the engineers around you. - You write clearly. Your writing should be concise, clear, and easy to follow. ### **Put Another Way, You Shouldn't Apply If** - You think of QA as gatekeeping. We don't have sign-off gates, and we're not adding them. Your influence comes from the quality of your judgment, not from a checkbox. - You're happiest when someone hands you a test plan and a set of instructions. This role operates on ownership, with you often deciding what to test and why. - You want to stay at the surface. Testing Ashby well means understanding it well. jobs.title: AI-native Product Manager
jobs.description: #### About ShortPoint ShortPoint is a design software company that helps teams build beautiful intranet sites inside Microsoft 365, SharePoint, and Microsoft Teams. We are a remote-first, globally distributed team certified as a Great Place to Work and ranked #4 out of 15 Best Workplaces in Technology in the GCC, with regional offices in Dubai, Lviv, Ann Arbor, and London. We believe teamwork makes the dream work, and we keep our teams in sync and winning at scale. We are looking for a meticulous, proactive, and technically grounded Technical Product Manager to join our product team and work directly with our Product Director to keep our product engine running with precision and a great eye for design. #### Role Overview We are seeking a hands-on Technical Product Manager to support the Product Director across the full product lifecycle. You will run and manage product meetings, turn ideas and discussions into clear, well-written user stories, create mockups with the help of modern AI tools, and keep everyone informed on the status of upcoming releases. The ideal candidate combines strong product craft with genuine design sensibility and a solid technical foundation: you can follow engineering discussions with ease, reason about APIs and architecture, and dig into technical details when the situation calls for it. The stronger your technical depth, the better. You will bridge the gap between engineering, UI/UX design, and business priorities, and you should be comfortable working AI-first across your daily workflow. #### Key Responsibilities - Product Execution: Assist with the day-to-day product cadence alongside the Product Director, from meeting management and follow-ups through backlog grooming, story writing, and release tracking - Story Writing: Write detailed, unambiguous user stories and acceptance criteria in Linear, and keep the backlog organized and sprint-ready - Release Communication: Track release progress across engineering and QA, and proactively inform stakeholders of status, risks, and timelines - AI-Assisted Design: Create wireframes and mockups using AI design and prototyping tools, and apply a strong eye for UI/UX to keep the product intuitive and polished (you will be asked to demonstrate this in the interview) - AI Process Improvement: Being able to contribute to our processes by utilizing AI (Claude/ChatGPT work) to analyze data, close gaps, and resolve bottlenecks. #### Required Qualifications & Experience ⚠️ Mandatory Screening Criteria: Candidates who do not meet the experience and background requirements below will not be considered. - Total Experience: Minimum of 3 years of hands-on product management experience specifically within software/SaaS environments - Industry Background: Must have direct experience working on B2B SaaS products; familiarity with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, or intranet products is a strong plus - Tools & Ecosystems: Advanced, hands-on proficiency with Linear (or a similar agile tracking tool), GitHub, and Claude (CLI and app) or comparable AI tooling - Design Literacy: Strong eye for design, foundational knowledge of UI/UX workflows, and proven ability to produce mockups with AI-assisted tools - Technical Foundation: A solid technical background with strong software development familiarity; able to hold your own in discussions about APIs, web technologies, and architecture with engineers. Deeper hands-on experience, such as with JavaScript/React or the Microsoft 365/SharePoint ecosystem, is a significant advantage - Include the word 'compass' in your application response to confirm you have read this posting carefully. - Big Plus: A Claude Code or Codex project of your own that you can showcase and explain in the interview - Location: Fully remote role; work from anywhere with reasonable overlap with the team

jobs.title: QA Engineer: AI-Assisted Testing
jobs.description: Join ECFX, a company transforming how the legal industry works through technology. Every day our platform pulls court notices and legal documents from hundreds of court portals and e-filing systems, categorizes them with AI, and delivers them into our customers’ document and case management systems. When something is late, dropped, or misfiled, a law firm can miss a deadline. We’re looking for a hands-on QA Engineer who loves finding what others miss, and who uses AI to do it faster and deeper. Our engineers build with AI coding agents, so changes arrive quickly and in volume. You’ll be the person who works out what could break and tests it thoroughly by hand, using AI as your co-pilot for test design, test data, investigation, and reporting. This is a testing role first. If you also enjoy building automation, there’s room to use AI to create targeted automated checks where they pay off. You will have a real say in how we build, test, and ship software. What You’ll Engage In Test Smarter with AI: Use AI tools (such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or ChatGPT) to read tickets, merge requests, and code diffs; map out risks and edge cases; draft test charters and checklists; and decide where to focus. You bring the judgment about what matters. Explore and Uncover: Run risk-based exploratory, functional, and regression testing across our Vue dashboard, admin tools, email notifications, and integrations. Find defects before customers do. Validate What Matters Most: Make sure documents are retrieved, parsed, categorized, stored, and delivered correctly across many external sources: court portals, 2FA/OTP logins, and integrations such as Clio, Filevine, iManage, and NetDocuments. Hunt for silent failures, where a document is dropped but the run reports success. Test Below the UI: Much of our work has no screen to click. Verify backend and platform changes by hand, using API calls, SQL queries, logs, and dashboards (Grafana/Loki, Sentry), with AI helping you write the queries and make sense of the output. Build Realistic Test Scenarios: Use AI to generate test data, sample court notice emails, and edge-case documents, and drive our simulators and test environments to reproduce hard-to-reach situations. Test Our AI Features: Evaluate our AI document categorization and our LLM-facing tools (an MCP server used by AI assistants). Build sample sets, check accuracy and consistency, try to break them with unusual or hostile inputs, and flag when a model or prompt change makes results worse. Guard Security and Access: Check logins (password, SAML SSO, OAuth), user roles and permissions, and that one firm can never see another firm’s data. Verify security fixes without breaking what already works. Reproduce and Triage: Investigate customer-reported and production issues, reproduce them reliably, and write bug reports clear enough that an engineer, or an AI agent, can act on them right away. Automate Where It Pays Off (Optional): If automation is in your toolkit, use AI to create focused automated checks, such as Playwright scripts or API checks, for high-risk flows you find yourself retesting. Agile Collaboration: Work with engineers and product managers in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Help write testable acceptance criteria and raise quality risks early What You’re Likely to Bring Professional Experience: 3 to 7 years in software quality assurance for web or SaaS applications, with deep experience in exploratory and manual testing of complex, data-heavy systems. AI Fluency ·You use AI assistants in your testing every day and can give concrete examples: generating test ideas and edge cases, building test data, writing SQL or log queries, summarizing logs or diffs, reproducing bugs, and drafting clear reports. Skill at prompting and giving context, such as feeding in the ticket, the diff, and the acceptance criteria to get useful output instead of generic answers. Healthy skep

jobs.description: About Tailor Tailor is a pioneer in Headless ERP technology. Our platform empowers companies to build internal workflows that adapt to their unique needs — faster, smarter, and developer-first. About the Role We’re looking for an Associate Forward-Deployed Product Manager to own the day-to-day execution of live client implementations. You’ll be the first line of communication with our clients and the person keeping the project moving — coordinating directly with the internal development team, tracking progress and blockers, running testing and training, and making sure what was committed is what gets delivered. You’ll work collaboratively with the Account Manager and Senior PM (Forward-Deployed Product Manager), who own the commercial relationship and solution design; you own the execution. This is a development role designed to grow into the Senior PM role. Progression is based on performance and can be accelerated accordingly. What You’ll Do Own Day-to-Day Client Communications — Manage day-to-day client communications, including question handling, escalation management, and requests to the client, keeping clients informed and unblocked. Drive Project Execution & Tracking — Run the execution rhythm of the project: coordinate with the internal development team, maintain project management tools (e.g., GitHub Projects, Jira), and keep status, documentation, and release notes current for internal and client teams. Client Data & Gap Analysis — Analyze client data to surface gaps, discrepancies, and risks, and support the Senior PM and engineering in solution architecture and functional gap analysis. Testing, Coordination & Go-Live Prep — Validate every release before it reaches the client, coordinate client testing and sign-off, and own go-live readiness. Testing is how we protect client trust — it is a core part of this role. Client Training & Enablement — Create training materials and deliver training so client teams are set up to operate the platform independently. Influence the Platform Roadmap — Develop deep knowledge of the Tailor platform and translate client feedback into product insights that inform the roadmap. What We’re Looking For 2–5 years of experience in product management in either big tech or a startup, and/or management consulting experience; management consulting strongly preferred Proven customer-facing experience, comfortable in front of both technical and non-technical stakeholders Sharp, structured thinker who is comfortable with ambiguity and eager to learn and grow Ownership mindset with an appetite for operational and technical detail Exceptional written and verbal communication skills Comfortable with data analysis tools and AI-driven workflows Nice to Have You build things in your spare time — show us a side project you’ve vibe coded and walk us through how you approached it Exposure to ecommerce or physical-product operations — order, inventory, purchasing, fulfillment, or accounting workflows Familiarity with ERP, 3PL, or commerce platforms Prior experience onboarding customers onto software Compensation & Benefits Salary: USD 100,000 to USD 130,000 yearly Benefits: Health, dental, vision, flexible PTO, and more Why Tailor? You’ll work directly with the product team on a fast-growing platform solving real operational pain. If you love being the voice of the customer, reducing friction, and making teams more effective — let’s talk. Apply now and help us shape the future of Headless ERP.

It does not own firmwide adoption, training or enablement for general-purpose AI tools.</p> <p>As the AI Product Manager, you will own product management across the AI Lab’s portfolio, with a particular focus on discovering and shaping new products and capabilities.</p> <p>You will work with teams across Brunswick to understand business problems and user needs, identify where bespoke AI can create meaningful value, and translate the strongest opportunities into clear product propositions and requirements.</p> <p>Acting as the bridge between users and engineers, you will help determine what to build, what not to build and where to focus.</p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:</p> <ul> <li>Identify and shape opportunities for new proprietary AI products and capabilities across Brunswick.</li> <li>Lead product discovery, understanding user and business needs, defining opportunities and testing whether ideas are worth pursuing.</li> <li>Turn promising ideas into clear product concepts, user journeys, requirements and prototypes.</li> <li>Work closely with AI Engineers through design and development, making pragmatic trade-offs between user value, functionality, speed and technical complexity.</li> <li>Own and prioritise the roadmap and backlog across the AI Lab’s portfolio.</li> <li>Run rapid pilots and user testing, using feedback and evidence to decide where to scale, adapt or stop.</li> <li>Ensure trust is designed into products from the outset, with appropriate consideration for governance, privacy, security, safety and responsible AI.</li> <li>Develop reusable capabilities that can scale across Brunswick rather than solving the same problems multiple times.</li> <li>Build strong relationships across Brunswick, translating between business needs and technical possibilities and engaging colleagues throughout product development.</li> <li>Stay close to emerging AI capabilities and identify where they could enable new products, differentiated capabilities or materially better ways of working.</li> </ul> <h2>What We’re Looking For</h2> <p>We are looking for someone who combines strong product judgement, creativity and structured problem-solving with the ability to turn emerging technology into practical, high-value products.</p> <p>You will be comfortable starting with ambiguous problems, moving quickly from insight to prototype, and working closely with engineers and users to find the right solution. The successful candidate will bring:</p> <ul> <li>5+ years of relevant product management experience, with a track record of delivering digital, software, data or AI-enabled products.</li> <li>Experience taking new products or capabilities from discovery and concept through to launch and iteration.</li> <li>Strong product discovery skills, with the ability to uncover genuine user needs and challenge assumptions about the right solution.</li> <li>Experience translating complex or loosely defined business needs into clear product requirements for technical teams.</li&gt
